scope: Bounded native Q4 receipt readback, not shared carrier or inverse

contract.start: Explicit Club button opens/focuses one Bench window, no extra player
contract.binding: Exact window references, allowed origin, 128-bit random per-open token, monotonic safe-integer sequence
contract.source_verification: Existing monitor first verifies actual iframe window, origin, fixed source name and native receipt coordinates
contract.freshness: Each Bench read invokes original iframe read; acknowledgment waits for newly validated source receipt
contract.clock_boundary: Timers only request/check connection health. They do not advance player, sequence, mixer or generation.
contract.failure: Missing/invalid/unloaded source, timeout, hidden monitor or closed peer => HOLD; explicit read required after hold
contract.open_layer: Coordinate displayed, layer comparison remains HOLD
contract.anchors: Player and Bench each compared to own captured record; asynchronous capture, not simultaneous shared state

browser_acceptance: NOT_PERFORMED. file-window opener restrictions, popup blocking and source visibility pause must be tested in the user's browser; fail closed if unavailable.
